author: CppCon
description:
Discover how to bridge the gap between high-performance computing and immersive graphics in this deep dive into real-time control, simulation, and visualization using C++23, CUDA, and Unreal Engine. 

In this tutorial, we explore the cutting-edge integration of NVIDIA CUDA for parallel processing and Unreal Engine for real-time rendering. Learn how to leverage modern C++23 features to build a robust pipeline that handles complex simulations while maintaining low-latency visualization. 

Key topics covered in this video:
- Setting up a high-performance compute pipeline with C++23.
- Bridging CUDA kernels with Unreal Engine’s rendering architecture.
- Optimizing real-time data transfer between the GPU and the game engine.
- Implementing low-latency visualization for complex physics and control systems.
- Best practices for modern C++ development in a graphics-heavy environment.
